answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity, and any proven fraud burns the deposit, making mass spoofing costly. Sybil resistance can work by stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to join an epoch, and peers challenge suspicious nodes through a random beacon that selects auditors. Honest agents earn reputation across each voyage of tasks, while a forged ivory token of merit fails verification. Cheap throwaway accounts thus cannot outvote genuine participants. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
